The optimization algorithm implemented relies on the Genetic Algorithm where the fitness function is constructed to account for different design constraints and requirements of the topology and the filter. The inductive components of the whole system are selected simultaneously, capturing hence the interaction between them in the design stage itself. It is shown that the arm inductor can contribute to attenuating the ac switching current ripple leading to smaller LCL filter volume and hence reducing the overall footprint of the converter.

articleTitle: Optimal PMU placement for small-signal stability assessment using Genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-objective method-ology for optimal placement of Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs) for small-signal stability assessment of a power system, through Prony analysis on the voltage signals measured by the PMUs, two objectives are considered: the optimal location with a minimum number of PMU and maximum SNR. The main idea behind the paper, is to use a multi-objective Genetic algorithm (MOGA) to find a good estimation of the eigen-values (frequency and damping) of both local and inter-area electromechanical oscillations in a power system, by finding the optimal number and location of PMUs giving system full observability and maximum signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). The proposed algorithm is tested in the IEEE 39-bus system, and the results have been validated with modal analysis from PSAT toolbox.

articleTitle: Multi-Stack Fuel Cells and Interleaved DC/DC Converters Interactions for Embedded Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper presents a comparison of three interleaved Boost converters allowing a low ripple of the stack current and predisposition to the operations in degraded mode (default appears on a phase). Then, was chosen the best topology in each multi-stack association architectures. In addition, this paper presents actions of relief of the faulty stack possible by an intervention on the interface power static converters and allowing the recovery of this faulty stack towards its healthy state.

articleTitle: Quadrotor Design Procedure and PID Control for Outdoor Free Flight
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper presents a guide of design procedure for an Unmanned Areal Vehicle quadrotor construction based on PID controller. The procedure includes system modeling with Euler angles, components choice and identification and PID controller synthesis. Simulation results and experimental validation for free flight in outdoor are presented to show the effectiveness of the proposed procedure.

articleTitle: Robust MRAC Supervision of a Multi-source Renewable Energy System Using Fractional-Order Integrals
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper investigates the electrical energy transfers in a multisource renewable energy system using fractional order model reference adaptive control (FO-MRAC). The considered system is composed of two sources (photovoltaic and lead-acid battery bank), a specific zero voltage switch full-bridge isolated buck DC/DC power converter and the resistive load. First we start with the presentation of dynamic equations describing the coupling of buck converters, then. The main contributions of this work are to proposes a FO-MRAC control design for the supervision of the electrical energy transfers control in a multi-source renewable energy system, the objective is to stabilize the system's current and voltage of DC/DC converters coupled on the DC bus of multisource renewable energy system with resistive load fluctuation. The simulation results are presented and show a fast dynamic response of the DC bus voltage and robustness to load and input voltage variations.

articleTitle: Optimal adaptive under frequency load shedding using Neuro-Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: Under frequency load shedding (UFLS) is well known and widely used emergency control scheme to prevent system instability under disturbances that cause large imbalance between load and generation. A properly design UFLS scheme should be able to shed the minimum amount of load necessary for a safe and smooth transition of the system from emergency conditions to a normal operating state. This paper presents an optimal adaptive under frequency load shedding using Neuro-Evolution Algorithm. The proposed method is able to determine the necessary of load shedding for several disturbances. This method has been tested on WSCC 3-machine, 9-bus system and compared with the conventional method.

articleTitle: Optimal distribution power system reconfiguration using Genetics Algorithms and Branch exchange
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper uses Genetic Algorithms (GAs) and the branch exchange method to solve the optimal reconfiguration in radial distribution systems subject to power loss reduction that determine the optimal switches. The GA is a relatively powerful intelligence evolution method for solving optimization problems. It is a population-based approach that is inspired from natural behavior of species. In this paper, GAs are applied to a realistic distribution system (106 buses) located in the Medea city (Algeria). For the comparison purpose, our method is validated with the classical Branch and Bound (B&B) method, widely used by the Distribution Companies. The results confirm the superiority of the GA.

articleTitle: A Simultaneous Resolution Method for Coupling Field\_Circuit Equations for Steady-State Skin Effect Problems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper describes useful implementation details of coupling simultaneously the circuit and field equations under MATLAB<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup>environment. The mathematical model allows to consider eddy currents in solid conductor in both axisymmetric and Cartesian cases. This approach yields a general coupling mechanism that keeps matrices symmetric.

Author Keywords: Eddy current, Solid conductor, Stranded conductors, MATLAB®

articleTitle: A New Sensorless Control of Doubly Fed Induction Motor Based on Extended Complex Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper presents a new method for the vector control of Doubly-Fed Induction Motor (DFIM) without using speed sensors or rotor position measurements. The proposed sensorless method is based on Extended Complex Kalman Filter (ECKF) for estimating the position and speed of the machine. This estimator is more attractive than the real one 'EKF' from the point of view of modeling and stability consideration. In order to implement this estimator, a sensorless control structure based on stator field oriented control is investigated in which two voltage inverters are used to supply the stator and rotor sides. The simulation results implemented on Matlab/Simulink shows effectiveness under various operating conditions (Low speed, nominal speed and high speed).

articleTitle: 3MA Non-destructive analysis on hardened material by finite element simulation and experiment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: In this paper, the 3MA NDT method for measuring hardening depth using harmonic analysis and incremental permeability is proposed. The flux density in hardened steel is examined using 2D FEM code taking into account the hysteretic behavior. The simulation results are validated by comparison to experiments and shows good accuracy. Correlation between magnetic quantities and hardening depth is determined

articleTitle: Improved Direct Power Control Applied to Parallel Active Filtering Based on Fuzzy Logic Controller
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper proposes a new fuzzy-direct power control (F-DPC) strategy for quality improvement in shunt active power filter system. The main objective of this study is to minimize the total harmonic current distortion (THDi) and the instantaneous power ripple. This is affected by the replacement of the hysteresis regulators by fuzzy rules. The basic idea of these rules is based on the acquaintance of the variation in the active and reactive power. Regarding to the input fuzzy variables and in a precise instant, the most best switching state of the converter is chosen. the strength of this control strategy, compared to the conventional DPC, are that it is not required to introduce hysteresis controllers, and sleek control of active and reactive power is achieved. The proposed F-DPC control was simulated and compared with conventional DPC under Matlab/Simulink 2013b. The obtained results show that the proposed configuration is better compared to the conventional configuration of the DPC based on hysteresis comparators.

articleTitle: Speed Control of Series-Connected Five-Phase Two PMSM using Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This work mainly studies the speed control of series-connected five-phase two permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs) using sliding mode control (SMC). Multiphase multi-motor series-connected drive system can achieve independent operating supplied from a single inverter. The dynamic response speed and overshoot is contradictory and the system is weak in terms of anti-interference in classical PI speed regulator. In this paper, the SMC is applied to the speed control of two five phase PMSM connected in series. Simulation results show that SMC can follow the reference speed quickly without overshoot and enhance the robustness of the system.

articleTitle: Comparison between existing transformer-less PV inverter topologies
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: In recent years, the interest in installing more photovoltaic systems to generate electricity power has rapidly increased. A number of reasons such as environmental concerns, electricity business restructuring, the fast developments of small-scale power generation technologies and micro-grid related systems can explain this trend. In order to improve the efficiency and reduce the cost of a photovoltaic system, many people are interested in PV inverter perfection, and this is due to the importance of this part in PV systems, it is the interface between produced and used electricity. In this paper we will focus on PV inverters, we will review available transformer-less PV inverters topologies and those topologies will be classified on the basis of applicability for photovoltaic uses.

articleTitle: Predictive Direct Torque Control Based on New Formulation and Fuzzy Logic for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper presents an alternative control strategy of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) drive, so called Model Predictive Direct Torque Control (MPDTC), its principle based on model system, prediction components and optimization problem. Then thus actuate the inverter. Conventional (MPDTC) both electromagnetic torque and stator flux are evaluated in the cost function. However, due to computation stator flux reference and prediction of stator flux in the next cycle, the control system has become more complicated. In this study the control algorithm successfully reduced by selected electromagnetic torque and daxis current as control variables. In addition, to improve the performance of speed tracking and increase the robustness against disturbance and uncertainties a PI-fuzzy logic controller is adopted in external speed loop where the conventional PI controller suffers from the parameters' variation. The obtained results proved the effectiveness of this strategy with encouraging performance which is manifested clearly when the suggested controller employed.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Numerical Over-current Relay Using LabVIEW and Acquisition Card
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: The project aims at the design and the construction of a numerical over current relay in PC using LabVIEW. It will acquire, sample and convert into digital form the analog current signals from a power system in real time using the NI USB-6009 acquisition card. When a current in a part of a power system exceeds a pre-set value due to a fault or a large overload, the relay will isolate the part through sending trip signal to a circuit breaker. In the developed laboratory model, a lamp board assembles the system. The overcurrent model is masked in a single subsystem (block) and a graphical user interface is provided where the user can select the type of overcurrent relay (Instantaneous, Time Definite or Inverse Definite Minimum Time IDMT). Furthermore, the user can select the different characteristic curves for IDMT overcurrent relay (Standard Inverse, Very Inverse, Extremely Inverse and Definite Time) and the relay settings (Current Set Point and Time Multiple Setting).

articleTitle: Discharges Current, Emitted Light and Radiated Field in Power Transformer Insulating Oils
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: The present paper deals with current, emitted light and radiated magnetic field simultaneous measurements in power transformers liquid dielectrics. They have been analyzed in both temporal and frequency domains. The investigation focuses on the nanosecond scale for electrical signals and Megahertz scale for spectral signals. The results enlightened that many similarities exist between the three parameters. They are characterized by a powerful frequency activity between 25 and 120 MHz. Moreover, it has been found, thanks to a simple ANN, that when the magnetic field is known, it is possible to predict the light emission variation with a good accuracy, and vice versa.

articleTitle: Wavelet transform of the leakage current to monitoring the insulator surface under non-uniform desert pollution
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This work is devoted to study the insulator behavior under non-uniform desert pollution. Our investigation is focused on monitoring of both position and width of polluted layer, and the electric discharge activity on the insulator surface, by the analysis of the leakage current waveform. The wavelet transform technique is used to decompose the leakage current signal at several frequency bands (details). The standard deviation (STD) is calculated for each detail. It is employed to find the details the most significant to get information on the surface state of the insulator. The STD of the high frequency details shows a good correlation with the electric discharges activity.

articleTitle: Improved control strategy for a stand-alone DFIG under unbalanced load conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved control strategy to regulate the stator voltage in stand-alone system based on doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) operating under unbalanced load conditions. This type of load results in unbalance of the stator voltage and current with subsequent power quality degradation and electromagnetic torque pulsations. The proposed control strategy uses the load-side converter (LSC) for the purpose of fully reject negative sequence of the stator voltage; this is achieved by employing proportional-resonant controllers (PRCs) for the closed loop stator voltage regulation built in the stationary reference frame without any rotating coordinate transformation and the sequence decomposition process. As a result, symmetrical AC voltage is applied to the stator terminal, which indicates that the rotor-side converter (RSC) can be still controlled with the traditional vector control strategy. Presented simulation results show that the proposed control scheme can eliminate effectively harmonics in the stator voltage and reduce the torque pulsations.

articleTitle: Wavelet Functions Performances in Intelligent Direct Adaptive Control of Uncertain Nonlinear Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: In this paper, a comparative study of wavelet functions performances in intelligent direct adaptive control is developed. The main idea is to investigate and compare the tracking accuracy of different wavelet activation functions in intelligent control of uncertain nonlinear systems. The most commonly used wavelet families such as Mexican hat, Morlet and Gaussian wavelet are subject of this study. Lyapunov's direct method is used to prove the stability and to derive the Wavelet Neural Networks (WNNs) parameters adaptation laws. The simulation results are presented to classify the wavelet functions under study.

articleTitle: On the Performance of FPGA Implementation of Block Matching Algorithms for Video Motion Estimation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: FPGA Implementation of pipelined architecture for video motion estimation is achieved and captured using Handel-C within DK4 suite environment. The developed architecture is ported on RC203 prototyping board, featuring a VirtexII XCV3000 FPGA device. Four famous algorithms which are the Full Search Algorithm (FSA), Three Steps Search algorithm (TSSA), Minimum Search Algorithm (MSA) and Diamond Search Algorithm (DSA) are implemented. To evaluate the architecture performances, three criterions are used: the processing speed (Computing Time: CT, measured in ms), image quality (Signal to Noise Ratio: SNR) and required hardware resources (number of occupied slices on the FPGA board). In order to achieve this task, three video sequences widely used in video processing (Akyo sequence, Forman sequence and Flower garden sequence), have been applied. Obtained results show that the computing time is enormously reduced up to 17%for 256x256 pixels/frame and up to 14% for 512x512 pixels/frame in respect to the one of FSA) when using TSSA, MSA and DSA, and this is without a big sacrifice in image quality and resources amount.

articleTitle: Computational Study of Surface Dielectric Barrier Discharge Plasma Actuator for Flow Control using COMSOL Multiphysics
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: In this work, we present a two-dimensional (2D) numerical model to describe the phenomenon of the flow in air plasma actuator, comprising two plane parallel electrodes separated by a dielectric layer.The simulation is developed through the use of the COMSOL software. We are interested in the development of gas flow model, in the studied actuator as a function of time, according to the fundamental Navier-stokes equations which govern the Newtonian fluid displacement. We studied the flow of gas with different actuator configurations, with initial conditions and well-defined boundaries conditions.The results obtained provide the velocity flow distribution and profile. The different geometries and initial velocity values affect the exit velocity of the flowing gas in the actuator. We have seen that the velocity is maximal on the upper electrode meaning that the electrode plays an important role in increasing the speed.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacitor Placement and Sizing in Radial Distribution Feeders using evolutionary Algorithm: a case study of the Algerian-Djanet distribution system
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: The optimal capacitor placement and sizing in radial distribution systems is considered as a nonlinear integer optimization problem, with locations and ratings of shunt capacitors being discrete values. The aims is to minimize the total real power loss and the overall cost of that of shunt capacitors while satisfying operating and power quality constraints. This paper investigates the implementation of an evolutionary algorithm based for solving the capacitor placement and sizing optimization problem with reduced annual operating cost. The proposed method has been practically applied to the IEEE 34 nodes and the Algerian-Djanet distribution system, and the computational results obtained showed that the proposed approach is capable of producing a high-quality solution. The results are compared with previous studies using recent heuristic methods.

articleTitle: Comparaison entre la Technique Vibratoire et la Technique des Courants Statoriques : Application au Diagnostic des Roulements à Billes
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: The diagnosis of defects affecting ball bearings used in electrical drives is a research area very studied given the importance of these organs in the transfer of energy. For this purpose, several diagnostic techniques have been developed. These techniques include vibration analysis, a widely used approach in industry, and the analysis of the stator current. The purpose of this article is to carry out a simple comparative study on the capacities and performances of each technique in the diagnosis of ball bearing defects of an asynchronous motor. The experimental results obtained show that these two techniques are complementary since their reliability depends on the defective element constituting the bearing.

articleTitle: Molecular Macroscopic Characterization of EPDM's Aging Used for Outdoor High Voltage Insulators
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: The Ethylene-Propylene-Diene Monomer (EPDM) is a material used for the housing of the high voltage composite insulators. The stress conditions related to that outdoor exposure causes alteration of the material's properties. Several characterization techniques were used in this study for the evaluation of the thermal aging of the EPDM. The FTIR technique was used to evaluate the molecular behaviors of the material. The Carbonyl Index measurement was used to assess the oxidation rate of the material along the aging by means of FTIR spectroscopy. The crosslink density was measured using the solvent swell method. For the macroscopic characterization, the surface roughness of the aged samples was measured. This study showed that both crosslinking and oxidation were observed within the studied samples with a linear variation along the aging time. The correlation between the molecular and morphological properties was investigated. This study showed that for each structural scale a phenomenon of degradation is observed during the aging. The erosion of the material observed by the use of the surface roughness measurement has an impact on the oxidation of the material which was monitored by the use of the FTIR spectroscopy. Both of these measured parameters increase along the aging time. This increase is more important when the aging temperature became higher.

articleTitle: PyPS: An Open Source Large Scale Power System Small Signal Analysis Software Package
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: this paper describes small signal stability analysis software package (PyPS) which is mainly an open source code with PyQt GUI based software package for either small/medium or large scale power systems as well. PyPS is performed with power flow calculation and small signal analysis modules. It contains many power systems components as different synchronous machines models, voltage regulators, FACT, DC lines and HVDC. PyPS is provided with a set of graphical interface to make it easy to handle for users. Many cases study are presented in this paper to illustrate the capabilities of the presented tool.

Author Keywords: adaptive dynamic Implicitly Restarted Arnoldi Algorithm

articleTitle: Characteristics of Zinc Oxide Varistor Ceramics sintered at high temperature
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: The microstructural and electrical characteristics of ZnO based varistors, which are composed of ZnO-Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Cr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>Sb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and Co<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> are studied in relation to sintering temperature, in the range of 1200°C 1250°C. Microstructure, and electrical properties were studied by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and direct current electrical measurement. The varistor ceramics had fine microstructures, the grain size varied from 2.23 to 2.96 μm. articleTitle: 3D Analytical Computation of the Torque in Axial Flux Permanent Magnets Couplings Based on Charges Model and Images Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper presents a simple and accurate 3D analytical expressions to compute the force and torque of an axial flux magnetic couplings (AFMC) based on the equivalent magnetic charges and the images method. The proposed model is formulated and solved in a 3D Cartesian coordinate system by considering the assumption of linearization around the mean radius. Firstly, the magnetic flux density due to the cubic permanent magnets (PM), of one side of the magnetic coupling, is computed in 3D considering the magnetic end effects where the iron yokes influence is considered thanks to the images method. Secondly, the force and the torque among the magnets located in the opposite sides are obtained using the analogy between the electrostatic and magnetostatic forces. The derived analytical expressions depend directly on the geometrical and physical parameters of the AFMC. The analytical results are compared to those obtained with finite element simulation and experimental measurements.

articleTitle: Comparative study between linear filter and discrete wavelet transform for denoising heart sounds signals
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: The phonocardiogram signal (PCG) is a physiological signal that reflects heart mechanical activity, is a promising tool for curious researchers in this field because it is full of indications and useful informations for medical diagnosis. Having a non-noisy PCG signal is not always accurate because the recording of this signal is interrupted by uncontrollable noise from the patient and the recording environment itself This is why in this article we propose two methods for denoising heart sounds including Discrete Wavelets Transform (DWT) and linear filter in order to obtain a signal apt for use.The DWT denoising process presents four methods in which the user has the choice of the most appropriate method to analyze his signal. A study was proceed these four methods to examine their performance. In the other hand, compare the optimal method resulting from this stage with a linear filter in order to judge the most appropriate way to deniose a PCG signal.

articleTitle: Simulation of a Positive dc Corona Discharge in a Needle-Plane Electrode Configuration
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: Two-dimensional axisymmetric model has been developed for the simulation of a dc positive corona discharge in a needle-plane configuration at atmospheric pressure using COMSOL Multiphysics. The continuity equations for electrons, positive and negative ions, including the effects of ionization, attachment, recombination, electron diffusion and photoionization, have been solved simultaneously with Poisson's equation. The spatial-temporal variations of the electric field, the electrons, positive and negative ions have been investigated.

articleTitle: Analysis of reference current identification strategies for shunt active filter under distorted load conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: Due to the increasing use of the nonlinear loads, shunt active filters have gained a lot of attention as an effective solution for harmonic current mitigation. One of the most important units in the shunt active filter is the reference current identification unit, because of its direct impact on the filter efficiency, it has been discussed in many researches and several theories are developed for the purpose of extracting the reference currents effectively. This paper examines the performance of two reference current identification strategies, namely, the synchronous reference frame or (SRF theory) and the instantaneous reactive power or (PQ theory) applied to a shunt active power filter under an unbalanced voltage conditions and a nonlinear load.

articleTitle: Reconfiguration of Control under Unbalanced Grid Voltage Sags for DFIG Wind System Using Power Harmonic Components
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper deals with an improved control for a variable speed wind system based on doubly fed induction generator under an unbalanced grid operation. The main goal of this control is to reduce mechanical stress by reducing electromagnetic torque oscillations. Under an asymmetrical grid sag, the conventional flux oriented control strategy is replaced by a novel control strategy based on a new calculation of reference currents using power harmonic components. A dynamic modelling of the doubly fed induction generator is proposed in both positive and negative frames. Theoretical analysis is developed to explain the proposed control. Simulation tests have been conducted under PSIM software and simulation results confirms the ability of the proposed control to mitigate the voltage sags effects.

articleTitle: Compressed Sensing based Speech Compression using Dictionary Learning and IRLS algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: Compressed sensing (CS) has gained much interests in the speech processing community and especially in compression. The success of this appealing paradigm relies, heavily, on the sparsity of speech signals in a given dictionary. Thanks to machine learning, it is possible to go beyond the limits of analytical dictionaries by designing learned dictionaries, which are more able to fit the nature of data. In this paper, we propose speech compression scheme based on CS using K-singular value decomposition (K-SVD) algorithm to learn a dictionary for sparse representation and iteratively reweighted least square (IRLS) algorithm for signal reconstruction from randomly generated measurements. Different sizes of dictionaries are trained and compared with discrete cosine transform (DCT). Signal quality results, measured with perceptual evaluation speech quality (PESQ) revealed that learned dictionary using K-SVD improves the performance of speech compressed sensing comparing to DCT.

articleTitle: Empirical Mode Decomposition for Speech Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: In this paper, we restrict in the use of the empirical mode decomposition (EMD) on the speech enhancement methods, the empirical mode decomposition (EMD) is based on an adaptive decomposition of the signal into oscillating components. A comparative study between the most recent EMD-based enhancement methods was performed. Experimental results show that the empirical mode decomposition can be used successfully in speech enhancement. The objective evaluation of the quality and intelligibility shows through an experimental evidence that the EMD-based speech enhancement methods provide a good performances.

articleTitle: The effect of BaTiO3 content on the microstructure and electrical properties of Bi2O3/ZnO varistor materials
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: The study deals with the 0 and 1 mol.% BaTiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> doped ZnO. Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>/ZnO based varistor containing 0.5 mol% of Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and 99.5 mol% of ZnO, has been manufactured by conventional ceramic procedure. Mixing has been sintered at temperatures in the range 1000 °C. Different, characterization techniques such as X-ray diffraction (XRD), scanning electron microscopy (SEM) equipped with energy dispersive X-ray (EDX) have been used. Microstructure and electrical characteristic have been analyzed as a function of the BaTiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> content and sintering temperature. Various oxides and, solid solutions such as Zncite, BaTiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> have been formed. Grain size and dielectric constant (') decrease when BaTiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> content increases whereas, non-linearity coefficient (á), electric fields (Eb) and the dielectric loss (Tanδ) increased, to reach respectively 12.09 and 44.35 V/mm in comparison with that of BaTiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>/Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>/ZnO based varistor.

articleTitle: Intensification of Essential Oil Extraction of Artemisia herba alba Using Pulsed Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: In Algeria, the essential oils market is very modest and the development of this sector remains a problem to be solved. Artemisia herba alba (white wormwood) is aromatic and medicinal plant rich in essential oils. It is in great demand by the national and international industrial sectors: pharmaceutical, food, cosmetics …). The extraction by conventional hydrodistillation gives low yield, a solution presented in this article is to make a pulsed electric field treatment to intensify the extraction of essential oils. The results indicate a good influence of the PEF on the efficiency of HE with reduction of the extraction time. The extraction yields obtained, for example being 2.05% for only 30 min of distillation after treatment with PEF (3kV / cm, n = 100) is 03 times more than a traditional extraction. This result will undoubtedly have a major socio-economic impact.

articleTitle: Fault Arc Resistance Impact on Fault Location in High Voltage Transmission line
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: Tow proposed methods are used to localize the fault in high voltage transmission line. The proposed methods use digital set of short circuit current and voltage measurements for estimating fault location for different fault types. In this paper, we stud the impact of the arc resistance on the fault location using these methods A practical case study is presented in this work to evaluate the proposed methods with results comparison and to evaluate the best mean to locate the fault. We will study the impact of the fault arc resistance on the error of the fault location, as well as the influence of the location on the error.

articleTitle: Modeling and Resonance Analysis of Parallel Grid-Connected Inverters with LCL Filters
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper investigates the complex resonances issue encountered in parallel grid-connected inverters. In this context, the presence of connecting LCL filters give advantages in cost and dynamic compared to L filters. Nevertheless, each LCL filter induces its specific resonance in the system, which results in complex resonance characteristics, especially in case of different LCL filter parameters. These resonances can lead to the whole micro-grid instability. To understand the resonance origins, this paper presents a comprehensive modeling method to illustrate the complex resonance phenomena. These phenomena are highlighted for the case of two parallel inverters with similar and different LCL filters.

articleTitle: Selection of Variables by the F-Score Algorithm for Radiated Magnetic Field Signals Discrimination of Electrical Discharges
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper proposes the use of a hybrid variable selection method called F-Score with proposed threshold, which reduces the duration of the training and the testing phases while improving the accuracy of recognition for radiated magnetic field signals discrimination of electrical discharges generally taking place in insulation systems and in particular in insulators of high-voltage lines and power transformers. The classifier used is based on support vector machines (SVMs). The experimental analysis was carried out on a basis of data containing 161 signals which 106 signals were reserved for the training and 55 signals for the testing. The obtained results show that the proposed algorithm combined with the SVMs, allows a substantial reduction in the number of variables and a high improvement of the recognition rate compared to the pre-selection rate.

articleTitle: Efficient Implementation of An Improved Median Filter on TMS320C6416 Digital Signal Processor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper proposes a new software design and hardware implementation to enhance grayscale images that are highly corrupted by impulse noise. However, the main objective is to remove the salt and pepper impulse noise using an improved median filter that performs spatial information processing to determine which pixels in an image have been affected by impulse noise then replace it only by the median value of the 2-D selected area which has low variance value. The proposed algorithm was optimized and implemented on a fixed-point TMS320C6416 Digital Signal Processor of Texas Instruments. The improved median filter (IMF) is successfully tested with multiple grayscale images and gives better Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) results than the Standard Median Filter (SMF), Recursive Median Filter (RMF), adaptive Median Filter (AMF).

articleTitle: Predictive Current Control of Three Level Neutral Point Clamped Grid Connected Inverter in Photovoltaic Generation Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper presents predictive current control technique for three-level NPC inverter connected to a photovoltaic panel through a DC/DC inverter, the application of MPCC strategy to 3L-NPC inverter based on the cost function is defined to minimize the error between the reference currents and predicted values, and balance the DC-link capacitor voltage, the optimal switching state that minimizes the cost function is selected and applied to the inverter. For the optimum use of the PV module, a maximum power point tracking (MPPT) controller is used which enables the maximum power extraction under varying irradiation and temperature conditions. Finally, the simulation results show that the suggested control achieves high performance and high degree of robustness while balancing the DC-link capacitor voltages.

articleTitle: Dynamic Equivalence approach for large-scale wind farms
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This study is investigating in dynamic equivalence of large-scale wind farms. Due to the large number of turbines that operate stochastically, many of them use a parameter identification approach. In this work, we propose a metaheuristic technique to identify a wind farm dynamic equivalent model for transient stability study. We use three different objective functions to study the impact of the objective function choice on the dynamic performance of the obtained system equivalent. The proposed approach is tested on IEEE 10-machine-39 Bus power system using 100 generators fixed speed wind turbines farm.

articleTitle: 3D Analytical Model to Compute the Electromagnetic Torque of Axial Flux Magnetic Coupler with A Rectangular-Shaped Magnet
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper presents a three dimensional (3D) analytical model to compute the electromagnetic torque of axial magnetic coupling with rectangular-shaped permanent magnets (PM's). First, an analytical 3D model in Cartesian Coordinates for calculating the magnetic field distribution in magnetic coupling with sector PM's is developed. Then, we approximate the rectangular shape of PM with sector-shaped having the same area and thickness. The electromagnetic torque is computed using Maxwell's stress tensor. The model's validity has been verified by comparing the results calculated by the analytical model with those obtained from the 3D finite element method and measurements.

articleTitle: A Balancing Method for Three-Phase SEIG Feeding a Single-Phase Load by using Switched Capacitors
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper deals with the balancing and voltage control of the three-phase self-excited induction generator (SEIG) supplying a single-phase load. This mode of operation normally causes an extreme unbalance in the generator. The proposed balancing method consists in changing the value of the excitation capacitor connected to the SEIG by using switched capacitors of different values. The values of the switched capacitors are chosen according to the value of the single-phase load connected to the SEIG. The study shows that by tolerating a certain degree of unbalance, a reduced number of switched capacitors permits to feed the single-phase load with the desired voltage over a wide operating range. Using the d-q model, the dynamic performances of the SEIG are investigated. In addition, a preliminary implementation of an experimental prototype based on electromagnetic relays and an Arduino microcontroller board is carried out. The computed and experimental results are presented and compared.

articleTitle: Magnetic Coupled Electrical Circuits Approach for Stator Fault Diagnosis of Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: Induction motor is known by robustness, simplicity and low cost of maintenance. However, it is subjected to mechanical, electro-dynamical efforts and overload, which leads to appearance of faults. In this context, this paper deals with the modeling and diagnosis of induction motor in event of stator faults.For that, a mathematical model based on Magnetic Coupled Electrical Circuits Approach (MCEC) is developed to diagnosis the stator faults in induction motors. Simulation results are carried-out to confirm the effectiveness of the developed mathematical model.

articleTitle: Constrained Fault Tolerant Control Design for Takagi Sugeno Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: The problem of constrained fault tolerant control (CFTC) with multiobjective requirement is investigated for Takagi-Sugeno systems subject to actuator faults. An integrated FTC strategy is adopted by combining a descriptor approach with the proportional integral observer (PIO) to guarantee the closed-loop system stability of the faulty system. Meanwhile, it can ensure the given saturation constraints on control input and the trajectory tracking performance. Based on Lyapunov theory, the optimization problem is formulated in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMI). Motorcycle simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed CFTC approach.

articleTitle: Non linear control of a Fuel Cell Interleaved Boost Converter using Weighted Mixed Sensitivity H∞
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: In this paper, we presented the modeling and an advanced control strategy of a fuel cell electric vehicle's power train. The studied power train included a fuel cell stack connected with a DC-DC converter that obtained by cascading interleaved boost and an interleaved double dual boost converters in order to get a high voltage ratio and small input current undulations. The designed controller ensures the well tracking and system stability thanks to the effectiveness of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> mixed sensitivity that was used to control the dc bus voltage. The proposed controller has been validated by the obtained simulation result using Matlab/simulink.

Author Keywords: Interleaved boost converter, interleaved double dual boost, Fuel cell, H∞

articleTitle: Analytical Modeling of Electromagnetic Noise in Spoke-Type Permanent-Magnet Machines
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper presents an analytical modeling of electromagnetic noise in spoke-type permanent-magnet (PM) machines (STPMMs). The two-dimensional (2-D) elementary subdomain (E-SD) technique in polar coordinates is used to predict the magnetic pressure, which is transferred to frequency domain and used in harmonic response mechanical analysis to predict generated electromagnetic noise. An electro-vibro-acoustic coupling based on a 2-D finite-element method (FEM) has been realized in order to validate the obtained results by the analytical modeling.

articleTitle: Electrical Equivalent Circuit and Glow Discharge Atmospheric Pressur
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: A dielectric barrier discharge generated by flowing inert (Helium) ionized by a high-Voltage of non-thermal atmospheric pressure glow discharge, are used on a large industrial scald. They combine the advantages of non-equilibrium plasma properties with the ease of atmospheric pressure operation.One of the most studied DBD configuration is the parallel electrode reactor. Its resultant model consists of tow capacitors in serial connection. The proposed model considers the geometry of the reactor and dielectric material.

articleTitle: Conduction and FT-IR spectroscopy to Study the Metal/liquid Contact
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This work aims to investigates the effect of the cathode interface on the aging process of transformer oil. The mineral oil is stressed with two different metal electrodes and the electrical response is illustrated through the current field features. For a same range of the applied constraints, the transformer oil behavior is ohmic with one of the used metals and it shows a regime of saturation with the other metal electrodes. The conduction behavior is correlated with FT-IR spectroscopy analyses, a certain modification in the structural composition of the insulating liquid seems to occur when appears the regime of saturation These observations indicate that the insulation aging may be linked to the nature of the used metals in the equipments.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control of Direct Drive PMSG Wind-Power Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: For the purpose of sensorless low speed control of direct-drive permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG)based wind power generation system, this paper presents a technique based on the rotating high-frequency voltage-signal injection. To improves the efficiency of the method and eliminate the phase shift introduce by the traditional filters, bandpass, low pass or high pass filters are substituted by Kalman filters. The effectiveness of the proposed sensorless low speed control is shown by numerical simulations using Matlab/Simulink environment. The simulation results show that the control scheme provides an accurate estimate of the position of the PMSG-wind turbine and shaft speed.

Author Keywords: Sensorless direct-drive permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG)
Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT): pitch angle control

articleTitle: Gap Estimation of Disbanding Failure Appears in Hybrid Laminate Material by Means of an Eddy Current Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to estimate the gap of a disbanding failure appears in the hybrid laminate material by means of the eddy current non-destructive evaluation (EC-NDE) method. In order to model and analyse the corresponding problem, a 3D FVM anisotropic numerical model is developed, in which the heterogeneity of the hybrid laminate material is taken into account. To estimate the gap of a disbanding failure, the developed model is hence inversed using the Nelder-Mead simplex algorithm. Both numerical and experimental results are given in this paper related to an experimental sample of the hybrid material.

articleTitle: Super-twisting strategy based indirect field oriented control without using the currents sensor: application to IM
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: Super-twisting strategy associeted to indirect field control for induction machine is presented in this paper. The main idea of this strategy is that it doesnt require in the current sensors for controlling the induction machine (IM).Indirect Field Oriented Control (IFOC) is known to generate high performance in IM drives by decoupling rotor flux and torque generating stator current components of the stator current. In order to decouple the torque and the flux, The both stator and rotor currents in the stationary and rotating frames can be derived from the corresponding rotor flux-oriented vector control requirements and motor dynamic equations. Closed-loop speed is controlled by the super-twisting to obtain a good trajectory tracking. The objective of the control strategy is to ameliorate the transient and reduce the oscillations on the couple and for a convergence in finite time concerning the rotor speed. The transient response analysis of the IM is also discussed in detail. Results based on matlab simulations have shown that demonstrate the control system demonstrates good dynamic performance and robustness.

articleTitle: Near field microscopy for the diagnosis and characterization of materials
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: In this work, a near field microscopy for diagnosis and characterization of materials is presented. The method is based on the association of microstrip microwave probes and a network vector analyzer. The reflection coefficient is measured as the tip of the probe sweeps and analyzes the device under test without contact. This tip radiates an electromagnetic field whose wavelength is large front of comparatively to the distance between the tip and the device. The variations of the reflection coefficient and the quality factor are related to the electrical properties of the material under the tip.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of Photovoltaic Systems Integrated to Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper presents a simulation model of all the electrical components constituting a PV (Photovoltaic) power plant connected to distribution network. The model contains a detailed representation of the main system components, this modeling is an essential step to evaluate the characteristics of a PV plant, all equipment represent the PV system connected to the network are modeled and simulated, such as, PV field, boost, inverter, filter and distribution network. It is opted for PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) command, because the power involved is important, which requires a control of the switching frequency. This paper focus on the control system which uses two control loops: an external control loop which adjusts the DC voltage and an internal control loop which regulates the active and reactive currents. The performance of the proposed model is verified by several simulation studies conducted under MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: A New Sensorless Control Of Doubly Fed Induction Motor Using A High Frequency Carrier Signal Injection Based On Non Linear Third Order Angle Tracking Observer
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper presents a new rotor position estimator for Doubly Fed Induction Motor (DFIM) based on carrier signal injection. This method uses a new way to extract the frequency component of the current signal, in which contains the rotor position information also a new method to estimate the position and the speed of doubly fed induction motor shaft. This estimator allows to have a better accuracy in the transient phases. In order to implement this estimator, a sensorless control structure based on stator field-oriented control is investigated in which two voltage inverters are used to supply the stator and rotor sides. The simulation results implemented on Matlab/Simulink show effectiveness under various operating conditions (Low speed, nominal speed and high speed).

Author Keywords: Non Lineair Third Order Angle Tracking Observer

articleTitle: Temperature and Pressure Effect of PEM Fuel Cell Behavior for Urban Electric Vehicle Moving in Hottest Region Under Several Road Topologies
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: The pressure and temperature of operation are key parameters in determining the performances and durability of proton exchange membrane fuel cell PEMFC. The PEMFC is influenced with the temperature and pressure variation. In our present work, many more tests were carried on 4WDEV moved in Saharan area. Our example is examined in one of the hottest regions in the Algerian Sahara region, exactly in Bechar city which is located in the south west of Algeria. So the basic idea of this paper is to understand the PEMFC under temperature and pressure variations of 4WDEV moving in the high temperature conditions under several road topologies. The aim of this work is to study the comportment of PEMFC for 4WDEV based direct torque control based space vector modulation DTC-SVM in a Saharan region. The temperature increased in the range of 25°C to 60°C and the pressure increased in the range of 3 bar to 10 bar. The performances of the proposed strategy controller give a satisfactory simulation results. These actual studies make sure the safety and the stability of this 4WDEV moving in Saharan regions where the future industrial's vehicle must take into consideration temperature and pressure variations.

articleTitle: Modeling of a Superconducting Radial Flux Inductor by a 3D Reluctance Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: In this paper we present a quick 3D model using reluctance network (RN) of a radial flux superconducting inductor dedicated to a synchronous machine. This inductor is made of two kinds of superconducting materials; two NbTi coaxial coils fed by currents in opposite directions and four rectangular YBCO pieces placed between the two coils to modulate the generated magnetic field. This inductor is fed by 260 A and cooled at 4.2 K. Flux densities computed by the 3D RN are compared to FE simulations and to experiments.

articleTitle: Practical Implemetation of Energy Management Algorithm on a Microgrid System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: -Research in Microgrid has taken recently more attentions in the context of solving the conventional centralized power network constraints. Combining information and power technologies, the efficiency and reliability of the power network have been improved dramatically. As an additional advantage, including renewable energy sources and storage in to form distributed energy systems has proven its aptitude to solved some economic and technical penalties appearing in classical centralized systems. However, appropriate energy management algorithms in hybrid microgrids are primordial to reach the objectives mentioned previously, for which, this paper has given a significant contribution. This work proposes a practical and efficient solution to implement a real-time energy management policy on a microgrid prototype based on commercial products. This method is implemented and tested successfully to manage the power flow between 6.3 KWp photovoltaic system; 4.5 KW lead-acid batteries and 3.6 KW programmable loads. The objective is to maximize the use of renewable energy while driving efficiently the storage system. Another target summarized in operating the microgrid in island mode as much as possible to improve its reliability.

articleTitle: Integral Backstepping Control for Double Star Induction Machine (DSIM)
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper presents an integral backstepping control (IBSC) for double star induction machine (DSIM) in order to steer the speed and flux to the desired references. The DSIM is powered by two three phase voltage source inverters (VSIs) using pulse width modulation (PWM). The stability of the closed loop is verified by exploitation of Lyapunov's theory. To proof the effectiveness of the proposed control, a comparative study is made with rotor field oriented control (RFOC) based on regulators proportional integral (PI). Simulation results via MATLAB/SIMULINK show that the IBSC has a fast dynamic, better load disturbances rejection and better tracking performance.

articleTitle: Etude des décharges électriques dans les mélanges soufreazote-cuivre
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper deals with the study of discharges in gas mixtures SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>-N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in the presence of copper impurity in order to improve the dielectric properties of SF6-N2, used in high-voltage circuit breakers. The ionization coefficient is an important indicator for assessing breakdown in SF6 and its mixtures. The discharge will be described by the Townsend model evolving in a weakly ionized and low pressure mixture. Two types of elastic collisions were considered: electron-electron collision and electron-ion collision. The electronic transport coefficients of the SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>-N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> mixture are obtained by integrating the Boltzmann equation in the stationary case and for a uniform field. The results show that N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> reduces the proportion of high energy electrons in SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>-N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> mixtures and that copper favors low energy electrons.

articleTitle: Longitudinal behaviour of grounding electrodes subjected to lightning currents using SSR based TLM
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This investigation is devoted to characterize the lon- gitudinal behaviour of grounding electrode subjected to first and subsequent lightning currents. The State Space Representation (SSR) based Transmission Line Method (TLM) has been used to obtain current and potential along the electrodes buried in resistive soils. A new time parameter consists in the ratio of the potential peak time to the current one has been proposed to identify the variation of the transient behaviour along grounding vertical and horizontal electrode. We show that soil resistivity, electrode length and impulse peak time of injected current are the most influential parameters.

articleTitle: Robust Attitude Control based on Continuous Differentiator and Adaptive Super Twisting for 3 DOF Quadrotor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: A quaternion-based spacecraft model is used in this paper to design a nonlinear control law based on the adaptive second order sliding mode Super Twisting algorithm. The robust controller combined with the quaternion representation is applied to an unmanned aerial vehicle for attitude tracking and stabilisation in presence of external disturbances, parameters uncertainties and singularities. The stability and finite time convergence are proved through Lyapunov function candidate. The experimental results related to a real-time quadrotor plateform are included to show and demonstrate the effectiveness of the quaternion-based control.

articleTitle: Synthesis of swarm based algorithms for the design of LFC in interconnected power systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: This paper presents a synthesis of recently developed swarm algorithms known as Salp Swarm Algorithm (SSA), Grasshopper optimization Algorithm (GOA), Whale optimization Algorithm (WOA), and Grey Wolf optimizer (GWO) for an optimal design of the Proportional Integral Derivative with Filter (PIDF) controller for the Load Frequency Control (LFC) of interconnected power systems. Investigations have been carried out on three areas reheat thermal system with the consideration of the Generation Rate Constraints (GRC) and Governor Dead Band (GDB) for more realistic study. The Integral of the Squared Error (ISE) and the Integral of the Absolute Error (L4E) have been used as a performance index. The effectiveness of the investigated algorithms been examined through a load disturbance in the first area. From the obtained results, one can conclude that all the transient responses almost converge to the same values.

articleTitle: Technico-economic comparison between two new triboelectric charging processes of insulating granular products and their application to the electrostatic separation of WEEE Comparaison technico-économique entre deux nouveaux procédés de chargement triboélectrique des produits granulaires isolants et leur application dans la séparationélectrostatique des DEEE
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: It seems important to point out that the combination of triboelectric charging and electrostatic separation techniques is one of the best alternatives for the recycling of waste electrical and electronic equipment (WEEE). Our job is to evaluate and study two new tribo-charging devices to isolate particles from products to be recycled; the first device consists of a PMMA cylinder in which one or more coaxial propellers drive the plastic pellets in a helical motion which promotes their triboelectric charging; the second device is arranged on two parallel axes of rotation, in the same cylinder, to create two descending helical aerodynamic movements, either in the same direction or in opposite directions, and thus to cause a large number of collisions between insulating granules , which will charge by triboelectric effect. The experimental design methodology was used for the modelling and optimization of two charging processes for electrostatic separation application using a treadmill separator where the products used are mainly: PA, PC, HIPS, ABS and PVC. The effectiveness of the device was evaluated by experiments carried out with mixtures of three different plastics, on an electrostatic separator with a metal conveyor. The feasibility of the separation is related to the nature of the walls of the tribo-aero electric charging device, but is not significantly influenced by the mass flow.

articleTitle: étude éxpérimentale de l'influence des longueurs de câble sur les perturbations conduites d’un convertisseur dc/dc de type buck
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: Electric power performs functions more and more varied thanks to the generalization of the use of static converters. These converters are based on the use of switched semiconductor components that generate fast voltage (dv/dt) and current (di/dt) variations. This causes HF electromagnetic disturbances (EMRs) which must be minimized in order to comply with electromagnetic compatibility standards [1, 2, 3]. DC/DC converters are an important part of the conversion chain. They are widely used in connections to storage batteries, photovoltaic systems, wind turbines, hybrid systems and in automotive applications [4]. This work is devoted to the experimental analysis of the influence of the position of a DC/DC converter between a source and a load with regard to the measured EMC emissions measured on the source, as a function of the length of the cables converter and converter-load and the connection of their shield to ground.

articleTitle: Understanding Interarea Oscillations in Power Systems Integrating Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: Analogy with mechanical systems is used to explain the phenomenon of local and inter-area oscillations induced by the integration of wind power. The mass-spring system dynamics are qualitatively compared to single area and multi-area power systems. Wind power is modeled as a multi-frequency periodic, random force. Modal analysis is performed on a two-area power system integrating a wind farm based on doubly fed induction generator (DFIG). The study justifies the dynamic interactions of wind turbine dynamics and poorly damped inter-area oscillations. It is shown that local oscillations may mutate into inter-area oscillation modes.

articleTitle: Automation and Advanced System Control of an Industrial Production Process using Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: Process controls (basic as well as advanced) are implemented within the process control system, which may mean a distributed control system (DCS), programmable logic controller (PLC), and/or a supervisory control computer. DCSs and PLCs are typically industrially hardened and fault-tolerant. Supervisory control computers are often not hardened or fault-tolerant, but they bring a higher level of computational capability to the control system, to host valuable, but not critical, advanced control applications. Advanced controls may reside in either the DCS or the supervisory computer, depending on the application. Basic controls reside in the DCS and its subsystems, including PLCs. Because we usually deal with real - world systems with real - world constraints (cost, computer resources, size, weight, power, heat dissipation, etc.), it is understood that the simplest method to accomplish a task is the one that should be used. Experts usually rely on common sense when they solve problems. They also use vague and ambiguous terms. Other experts have no difficulties with understanding and interpreting this statement because they have the background to hearing problems described like this. However, a knowledge engineer would have difficulties providing a computer with the same level of understanding. In a complex industrial process, how can we represent expert knowledge that uses vague and fuzzy terms in a computer to control it? In this context, the application is developed to control the pretreatment and pasteurization station of milk localized in Batna (Algeria) by adopting a control approach based on expert knowledge and fuzzy logic.

articleTitle: Multilevel Fast Multipole Acceleration for Fast ISAR Imaging based on Compressive Sensing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: In this paper, compressive sensing (CS) is introduced into an efficient numerical method multilevel fast multipole acceleration (MLFMA) for the electromagnetic scattering problem over a wide incident angle. The resulted data from CS based MLFMA are processed to inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) imaging. Simulation results in maritime surveillance for the classification of ships and aircrafts show the received data for ISAR imaging from MLFMA with CS can reach the outperforms of MLFMA and achieves a quality similar to that of classical ISAR imaging. Furthermore, the computational complexity is improved by CS obviously through the reduced matrix computation for the fewer incident waves. An illustration with Aircraft Model Imaging confirms the usefulness of CSMLFMA.

articleTitle: A New Approach for Adaptive Frequency in series resonant inverter for Induction hardening
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: In metal Hardening applications, induction heating is often sought after, during the treatment process the load parameters vary from 500°C especially for soft steels. The heating system uses a high-frequency resonant series inverter supplying an inductor with the XC3S heating element. Due to the amount of losses due to large switching and the variation of the material parameters at high temperatures, resonance operation is essential in order to keep the system at peak efficiency. Therefore, frequency matching is recommended.. In this paper, the phase locked loop (PLL) is analyzed and simulated. In addition a new frequency tracking technique according to the temperature profile is proposed and implemented on the TMS320F2S335 DSP. The experimental tests are carried out on a test bench of 1kW over a range of working frequencies between 21 and 31kHz. The results obtained show its effectiveness with a flexibility of adaptation to various profiles of metal treatment. The latter appears more interesting from the implementation point of view when compared to the conventional PLL technique.

articleTitle: Antenne micro-ruban directive en utilisant une lentille à base de metamatériau
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
abstract: In this work, we are interested in improving the directivity of a 5GHz resonant circular patch antenna by exploiting the technology of metamaterials. A lens has been designed based on metamaterial which has a very high refractive index around the resonance frequency of the antenna. It has been placed above the patch antenna. The performance analysis of the lensless and lenticular antenna was performed by simulation with the CST Microwave Studio software. The results of the simulation show the improvement of the directivity, the reflection coefficient and the gain.

articleTitle: The effect of Sb2O3 content on the microstructure and electrical properties of (Mn2O3, V2O3)/ZnO varistor materials
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Electrical Sciences and Technologies in Maghreb (CISTEM)
